authority: Candidate implementation; not Product Truth, production, clinical or empirical validation
title: Whole-program coaching architecture
summary: An additive Node24 reference compiler and longitudinal reviewer join goal, athlete facts, reusable science boundaries, run/strength tasks, hybrid configuration and event horizon. Programs are conditional candidate state; actual execution is a separate immutable ledger. The implementation starts from current complete self-reported tasks and combined weekly exposure, rather than inventing uncalibrated doses. This is a bounded compiler and reactive trajectory, not independent invention of an optimal performance program.
invariants: completed physical work cannot be rewritten or rescheduled
current policy hash and independent science authority required
clinical signals never become dose-tolerance evidence
limits: No production persistence/authenticity of external sources
Complete task repertoire and combined-week context still required
